config:
cli_auth_credentials_store = "file"
service_tier = "default"
web_search = "live"
default_permissions = "evaluation"
allow_login_shell = false

[features]
fast_mode = false
memories = false
external_agent_memory_import = false
apps = false
remote_plugin = false
multi_agent = false
multi_agent_v2 = false
hooks = false

[memories]
use_memories = false
generate_memories = false

[apps._default]
enabled = false

[analytics]
enabled = false

[shell_environment_policy]
inherit = "all"
experimental_use_profile = false

[permissions.evaluation.filesystem]
":minimal" = "read"
":workspace_roots" = "write"
"/usr" = "read"
"/bin" = "read"
"/System" = "read"
"/Library" = "read"
"/opt" = "read"
"/tmp" = "deny"
"/private/tmp" = "deny"
"/Applications/ChatGPT.app/Contents/Resources/codex-cli" = "read"
"<SHARED_RUNTIME>" = "read"
"<BROWSER_RUNTIME>" = "read"
"<CELL>/profile/home" = "write"
"<CELL>/profile/tmp" = "write"
"<CELL>/profile/home/.codex/auth.json" = "deny"

[permissions.evaluation.network]
enabled = true

[marketplaces.os-practical]
source_type = "local"
source = "<CELL>/marketplace"

[plugins."opensocrates@os-practical"]
enabled = true
